title: Euclidean coefficient bound |α| ≤ (n+1)!·√(P^n) for the determinant covector (supplied step 8)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let A : ℝ^P → ℝ^{n+1} be a continuous linear map with operator norm ‖A‖ ≤ 1, let p ∈ ℝ^{n+1} with |p| ≤ 1, and let α be an n-covector on ℝ^P (Covector (Euclid P) n) with α(a_0, …, a_{n−1}) = det[p, Aa_0, …, Aa_{n−1}] for all a_0, …, a_{n−1} ∈ ℝ^P (the determinant of the (n+1)×(n+1) matrix with column 0 equal to p and column k+1 equal to Aa_k). Then covectorEuclideanNorm(α) ≤ (n+1)!·√(P^n), where covectorEuclideanNorm(α) = (Σ_{I : Fin n → Fin P strictly increasing} α(e_{I(0)}, …, e_{I(n−1)})²)^{1/2} and e_0, …, e_{P−1} is the standard basis of ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid (n + 1)) (p : Euclid (n + 1)) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), ‖A‖ ≤ 1 → ‖p‖ ≤ 1 → (∀ a : Fin n → Euclid P, α a = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun r c : Fin (n + 1) => (Fin.cons p (fun k : Fin n => A (a k)) : Fin (n + 1) → Euclid (n + 1)) c r)) → covectorEuclideanNorm α ≤ ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) * Real.sqrt ((P : ℝ) ^ n)
